sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include verapamil hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 209 tablets of the 120 mg presentation at a daily use of 9.5, providing 21.9 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 442 tablets of the same strength at a daily use of 14.1, providing 31.4 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Actavis Pharma, Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
The product label for the current supply names Proficient Rx LP as the registered plant (FEI 3011557028) with operations listed as RELABEL and REPACK.
FDA inspection records for that plant show a VAI classification on 2015-10-22 and another VAI on 2022-12-08.
